<thought>Now that we have the list of available functional groups, we can search for a template that breaks a halide (e.g., aryl halide) and forms a ketone, which corresponds to a Friedel‑Crafts acylation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccc(CNc2c(C(=O)Nc3cccc(OC)c3)nnn2Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
